title: Goats in Blankets
description: Bacon-wrapped, goat's cheese-stuffed dates — half pigs in blankets, half devils on horseback. Perfect party snack or festive nibble.
steps: Cut each slice of bacon in half lengthways.
Whip the goat's cheese gently with a fork to soften.
Remove the date stones if not already pitted. Widen the hole with the back of a teaspoon.
Stuff each date with a generous teaspoonful of cheese. Wrap a strip of bacon around it, stretching as needed, and secure with a cocktail stick.
Place on a baking sheet and bake for 8–10 minutes, turning halfway. Rest on kitchen paper briefly to drain, then serve.
notes: Makes 12 pieces. Per piece estimate. Keeps a few days in the fridge.
